title: juncus bufonius subsp. insulanus
intro: Juncus bufonius subsp. insulanus, commonly known as the "toad rush", is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the genus Juncus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Juncus bufonius subsp. insulanus include mucilage, demulcent, and anti-inflammatory actions, which contribute to its use in treating coughs, sore throats, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
